 Barcelona defender offered to AS Roma by superagent as January exit looms
 Published
 1 day ago on
 24/10/2026 
 By
 Michel Durant 
 Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images 
 Comment 
 Tweet 
 Alejandro Balde could be heading towards the Barcelona exit after losing prominence under Hansi Flick, with his agent, Jorge Mendes, reportedly exploring potential destinations ahead of the January transfer window.
 Indeed, according to Italian newspaper Il Messaggero (h/t SPORT ), Mendes has offered the left-back to Roma, who are assessing whether to pursue a move in January. 
 The Italian club are looking to strengthen their options on the left flank, and Balde is among the players being considered.
 A loan until the end of the season with an option to buy is understood to be one possible arrangement. 
 Such a deal would allow Roma to recruit the Spain international without making a substantial immediate investment, while Barcelona could retain the opportunity to secure a significant transfer fee next summer.
 Roma consider Alejandro Balde as Barcelona exit gathers momentum
 Roma, managed by Gian Piero Gasperini, are evaluating the possibility of bringing Balde to Italy as they look to reinforce their left-back position.
 Balde has fallen out of favour at Barcelona. (Photo by Daniela Porcelli/Getty Images) 
 The proposed loan-plus-option to buy structure could suit both clubs. Roma would have the opportunity to assess the defender before committing to a permanent transfer, while Barcelona would retain flexibility over his long-term future.
 However, the reported interest has not yet translated into a formal approach. Any potential deal would require approval from Barcelona and the player himself.
 Roma are not the only Italian club to be linked with Balde. Juventus have also explored his situation in recent weeks, with a loan including an option to buy previously emerging as a possible formula.
 Barcelona’s reported valuation of around €50 million has been a significant obstacle, making negotiations over a permanent transfer more complicated.
 Hansi Flick’s selection choices leave Balde facing an uncertain future
 Balde’s reduced role under Flick is central to the growing speculation surrounding his future.
 The defender had previously established himself as an important part of Barcelona’s first team, but competition for places has limited his opportunities this season. 
 Balde is behind Xavi Espart and Joao Cancelo. (Photo by Yasser Bakhsh/Getty Images) 
 The permanent signing of Joao Cancelo and the emergence of young defender Xavi Espart have provided Flick with alternative options on the left flank.
 That change in the pecking order has prompted questions about whether Balde can regain his former status at the club or whether a move elsewhere would offer a better opportunity to play regularly.
 At 22, the Barcelona academy graduate still has considerable time to develop, and his contract runs until June 2028. 
 His situation is therefore not necessarily one in which Barcelona must sell immediately, but a lack of consistent minutes could make a temporary departure attractive to the player and his representatives.
 A loan could give the defender a fresh start while allowing Barcelona to reassess his position before next summer’s transfer window.
